home.pillars.title: Learn, share and build better platforms.
home.pillars.meetups.title: Monthly talks
home.pillars.meetups.body: Real cases from Peruvian and regional teams: what they built, what they learned and what they'd do differently.
home.pillars.workshops.title: Hands-on
home.pillars.workshops.body: Backstage, Crossplane, Kubernetes and more, in practical sessions in Lima, the regions and online.
home.pillars.resources.title: Curated knowledge
home.pillars.resources.body: Guides, courses and articles from the global community, with Spanish summaries.
home.what.title: What is platform engineering?
home.what.body: It's the discipline of designing and building self-service internal platforms so development teams can ship software with less friction. A good platform reduces cognitive load, standardizes the repetitive work and lets each team focus on its product.
home.what.idp.title: Internal Developer Platform
home.what.idp.body: The layer of tools, workflows and self-service that connects your infrastructure with the teams that use it.
home.what.golden.title: Golden paths
home.what.golden.body: Recommended, proven paths to create, deploy and run services without reinventing anything.
home.what.product.title: Platform as a product
home.what.product.body: Developers are your users: research, prioritize and measure adoption like any other product.
home.what.devops.title: DevOps that scales
home.what.devops.body: It doesn't replace DevOps: it makes it sustainable as the organization and the number of teams grow.
home.university.title: Learn with Platform Engineering University
home.university.body: Free courses and trainer-led certifications from the global community. Start with the introduction and build a study group with the community in Peru.
home.cfp.title: Want to give a talk?
home.cfp.body: Our call for papers is open all year. We look for real stories, not product demos.

resources.more.title: Want more?
resources.more.body: The platformengineering.org blog publishes new articles every week, and Platform Weekly sums them up in your inbox.
community.title: We are the Peruvian platform engineering chapter
community.lead: An open community of platform engineers, SREs, DevOps practitioners and tech leads sharing what they learn building internal platforms in Peru.
community.participate.title: How to take part
community.attend.title: Attend a meetup
community.attend.body: Every month we get together to hear a real case and talk. It's free and open to every level.
community.speak.title: Give a talk
community.speak.body: Solved something interesting in your platform? We'll help you prepare your first talk.
community.host.title: Host or sponsor
community.host.body: Lend your office for a meetup or support the workshops in the regions.
community.global.title: Connected to the global community
community.global.body: We are part of the global platformengineering.org community: hundreds of thousands of practitioners, PlatformCon and a university with free courses. We bring that knowledge to the Peruvian context.
community.coc.title: Code of conduct
community.coc.body: We want a safe and respectful space for everyone, regardless of experience, gender, background or way of thinking. We do not tolerate harassment in any form, at events or in our channels. If you see something wrong, reach out to the organizers.
